name: grade-scale-tools
description: Development-only formatting and browser checks for Grade_scale

scripts.format: prettier --write src/main/resources/static/*.{html,css,js} docs/*.md README.md package.json scripts/*.mjs .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/main/resources/static/*.{html,css,js} docs/*.md README.md package.json scripts/*.mjs .github/workflows/*.yml
